By giving a child the name Eshita, parents are passing on this blessing and hoping for a prosperous and abundant future for their child.

It serves as a reminder that with hard work, determination, and the blessings of the divine, one can overcome adversity and achieve material and spiritual success. Additionally, it can be seen as a call to cultivate a mindset of gratitude and generosity, as the name Eshita is associated with the Goddess of wealth, who is known to bestow her blessings not just on herself, but also on those around her. Overall, the name Eshita carries a deep spiritual significance, urging its bearer to strive for prosperity, both materially and spiritually, and to use their blessings to help others in need.
